verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents version history, which it frames as recovering 'any version of any file at any time', plus share revocation and a Shared Drive 'archive'. None of this shows user control over how long data is kept or how to delete it. There is no evidence of retention settings, permanent deletion, purging version history or indexed and transcribed data, or account and data deletion, so this applicable privacy axis is unevidenced.
